harbor.practice: Harbor retrieves current expense limits at query time; a small fine-tune only fixed answer formatting.
harbor.failure: Putting private facts into model weights and assuming deleting the source document removes them.

harbor.practice: Harbor keeps each reimbursement limit and its exception in the same chunk, with a parent link to the full section and the policy's effective date as metadata.
harbor.failure: Trying to fix poor PDF parsing by switching to a stronger answer model.

harbor.practice: Harbor's BM25 leg finds error codes like E-4012 and part numbers; the dense leg finds "can't get into my account" → "authentication recovery".
harbor.failure: Assuming a vector database chooses a good embedding model for you; it only stores and searches vectors.

harbor.practice: Harbor measures its HNSW index against exact search (ANN recall) and, separately, against human relevance labels (retrieval quality).
harbor.failure: Raising ANN recall to fix a representation that ranks the wrong passages close to the query.

harbor.practice: Harbor fetches 50 lexical + 50 dense candidates under the user's ACL filter, fuses with RRF, reranks the top 30 and assembles 5 non-duplicate passages.
harbor.failure: Adding raw BM25 and cosine scores together; their scales mean different things.

harbor.practice: "Can my team claim this?" makes Harbor resolve "this" from history, look up the user's region and role, then retrieve both the base policy and the regional exception, or ask a clarifying question.
harbor.failure: Citing a whole 80-page document when the answer depends on one clause.

harbor.practice: Harbor reports Recall@10 on 300 pooled, labelled real queries per release, with per-query diffs for anything that regressed.
harbor.failure: Reading retrieval metrics as answer quality; they do not measure whether the answer was supported.
